scripts.build: npm run bundle:ui && antora --stacktrace --fetch --cache-dir cache --redirect-facility static --clean site-dev.yml
scripts.build:ci: npm run bundle:ui && antora --stacktrace --fetch --cache-dir cache --redirect-facility static --clean site-ci.yml
scripts.clean: rm -rf public cache src/ui/dist www tmp
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n watch,serve 'npm run watch' 'npm run serve'
scripts.lint: npm run bundle:ui && antora --stacktrace --fetch --cache-dir cache --log-failure-level=warn site-dev.yml
scripts.lint:ci: npm run bundle:ui && antora --stacktrace --fetch --cache-dir cache --log-failure-level=warn site-ci.yml
